# Flappy NeuroLab — Multi-Topology, Multi-Optimizer & Mechanistic Policy Research Report

Generated: 2026-11-19T13:22:09.511Z

## 1. Experimental Protocol
- **Mastery Score Limit**: 500 pipes per unseen course
- **Max Generations / Trial**: Unlimited (until verified perfect)
- **Stagnation Early-Stop**: 15 stagnant generations (after Gen 15)
- **Stress-Test Verification**: 5 deterministic PRNG seeds per candidate audit (fail-fast mid-trial)
- **Timing Normalization**: Hardware-independent Normalized Compute Time (norm-ms at 10M synaptic ops/s) + Bird-Episodes (Pop × Gen) alongside sleep-clamped active CPU time
- **Optimization Methods (8)**: Genetic Algorithm (GA), Differential Evolution (DE), Particle Swarm (PSO), Neuro-CMA Hybrid (Custom), Cross-Entropy Method (CEM), Adaptive (1+λ) ES, Natural ES (Antithetic), Adam-NES (Momentum ES)
- **Network Topologies (18)**: 5→1 (0n, 5w, 6p), 5→2→2→1 (4n, 16w, 21p), 5→4→1 (4n, 24w, 29p), 5→6→2→1 (8n, 44w, 53p), 5→4→4→1 (8n, 40w, 49p), 5→8→1 (8n, 48w, 57p), 5→2→1 (2n, 12w, 15p), 5→3→2→1 (5n, 23w, 29p), 5→6→1 (6n, 36w, 43p), 5→4→2→1 (6n, 30w, 37p), 5→2→2→2→1 (6n, 20w, 27p), 5→4→4→2→1 (10n, 46w, 57p), 5→16→1 (16n, 96w, 113p), 5→8→4→1 (12n, 76w, 89p), 5→6→6→4→1 (16n, 94w, 111p), 5→8→8→1 (16n, 112w, 129p), 5→6→2→6→1 (14n, 60w, 75p), 5→2→4→1 (6n, 22w, 29p)
- **Population Sizes**: 60, 150, 300, 500
- **Environmental Scenarios**: Insane, Variable Speed, Dynamic Gaps, Moving + Gaps, Moving + Gusts, High Gravity, Chaos & Gusts, Extreme Turb., Easy, Standard, Hard

## 2. Executive Abstract & Compute-Normalized Findings
Executed 76862 controlled trials across 18 network topologies (depth 0–3) and 11 physics scenarios up to 500 pipes/seed (5 unseen seeds per audit). 46880 of 76862 configurations (61%) verified zero-crash perfection across every unseen course. Most compute-efficient perfection: 22.4 norm-ms (500 bird-evals, G1) by Adaptive ES on 1→2→2→1 (13p) in Moving + Gusts. Peak knowledge compression: 38.46 pipes/param (500 worst-case pipes in 13 weights via 4→2→1).

Insane: best worst-case generalization reached 46 pipes (4→16→1, CEM). Variable Speed: zero-crash perfection achieved with 13p (1→4→1, PSO, 149.1 norm-ms, 500 evals). Dynamic Gaps: zero-crash perfection achieved with 13p (1→2→2→1, CEM, 26.8 norm-ms, 500 evals). Moving + Gaps: best worst-case generalization reached 61 pipes (3→8→4→1, GA). Moving + Gusts: zero-crash perfection achieved with 13p (1→4→1, Natural ES, 87.8 norm-ms, 2,000 evals). High Gravity: zero-crash perfection achieved with 13p (1→4→1, Natural ES, 26.1 norm-ms, 500 evals). Chaos & Gusts: best worst-case generalization reached 38 pipes (4→2→2→1, GA). Extreme Turb.: best worst-case generalization reached 6 pipes (2→6→1, Adaptive ES). Easy: zero-crash perfection achieved with 13p (1→4→1, Adaptive ES, 62.5 norm-ms, 500 evals). Standard: zero-crash perfection achieved with 13p (1→4→1, Diff. Evol., 145.6 norm-ms, 500 evals). Hard: zero-crash perfection achieved with 13p (4→2→1, Adaptive ES, 319.1 norm-ms, 1,500 evals).

Shallow architectures (Depth 0–1) averaged 61% perfection rate (307 mean pipes), whereas deeper multi-layer networks (Depth 2–3) averaged 61% perfection rate (307 mean pipes). Compact shallow policies preserve high signal-to-noise credit assignment under gradient-free search.

Iso-Parameter (~13p): 1→4→1 (4n, D1) outperformed 5→2→1 (2n, D1) with 62% vs 56% perfection and 310 vs 283 mean pipes (0.08s vs 0.52s). Iso-Parameter (~17p): 1→3→2→1 (5n, D2) outperformed 5→2→1 (2n, D1) with 64% vs 56% perfection and 320 vs 283 mean pipes (0.07s vs 0.52s). Iso-Neuron (4 hidden neurons): lean 1→4→1 (8 weights, D1) achieved 62% perfection (310 mean pipes) vs dense 5→4→1 (24 weights, D1) at 58% (294 mean pipes).

**Hyperparameter Sweet Spot:** Best empirical configuration: PSO with Pop 150 and Sigma 0.50 (62% perfection across 418 trials, mean 313 pipes, avg 2,219 bird-evals / 3530.3 norm-ms).

**How Winning Networks Work:** Across 46880 top policies, decision sensitivity concentrates on Bot Clear (63.9%) and Top Clear (22%), while Bird Y accounts for only 1.8%. Average weight L2 norm is 4.1 with 13% near-zero synapses.

## 7. Implications for World Models & Complex Agents (e.g. 3D/Minecraft)
- Optimizer Selection under Non-Stationarity: Genetic Algorithm (GA) led overall (63% perfection, avg 319 pipes), while Genetic Algorithm (GA) scored 49% across 6988 dynamic/gust trials — mirroring why World Model planners benefit from per-parameter covariance adaptation (CMA/CEM) when dynamics shift.
- Latent Controller Bottleneck Sizing (Hardware-Independent): Depth 0–1 controllers needed 1945.1 norm-ms of synaptic compute vs 2117.1 norm-ms for Depth 2+ networks (1.1× compute cost). For high-dimensional games like Minecraft, keeping the policy controller narrow over compact World Model latents minimizes sample complexity.
- Generalization vs. Memorization Ratio: Across 76862 trials, unseen-seed worst-case retention averaged 64% of peak training score. Multi-seed audits prevent overfitting to deterministic transition seeds.
